title: completion::suggest call is not inside thread::spawn

blocking-call-outside-spawn.message: This completion::suggest call is not inside a thread::spawn closure, so it runs on the caller's thread.
blocking-call-outside-spawn.help: Move the call inside a thread::spawn closure, or confirm this call site is intentionally synchronous.

metadata.source: Synthetic example demonstrating span::contains as a general containment primitive: a call is flagged unless a structurally unrelated span (a thread::spawn call) encloses it.
